baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction وَجَدَكَ ... ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ joins encounter, a state off aim, and an immediate answering act of guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Finding discloses the addressee as missing the intended course; the fa-transition makes gentle route-giving the fitting response rather than leaving ضَالًّا as a static label.

activation_trace.role: Finding and coming upon supplies the encounter that reveals the condition.
Departure from guidance or aim defines the condition functionally as being off course.
Gentle indication toward a way or truth supplies the corrective motion.

changed_reading.before: A bare assertion that the addressee was astray and was then guided.
changed_reading.after: A compact event-chain: encounter exposes a missed course, and guidance answers by gently making a viable way available.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch range of ضَالًّا includes disappearance and hiddenness, while وَجَدَكَ and هَدَىٰ can mark rediscovery and the emergence of a lead.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is not only off route but obscured from view or absorbed into an undifferentiated field; being found reverses concealment, and guidance places a leading edge before him.

activation_trace.role: Coming upon what was not evident provides the reversal from concealment to encounter.
Hiddenness and disappearance recast the predicate as obscurity rather than only wrong direction.
The leading front part gives the newly visible subject something ahead to follow.

changed_reading.before: ضَالًّا names exclusively a mistaken orientation.
changed_reading.after: It can also name an obscured or unmanifest condition from which encounter and a visible lead bring the addressee forth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَجَدَكَ can be the finding of a lost thing, ضَالًّا can be unlocatable loss, and هَدَىٰ can supply course and intended direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar permits a recovery model: a lost one is located and then not merely possessed but assigned a course, converting recovery into purposive movement.

activation_trace.role: Finding a sought or lost thing supplies the recovery event.
Loss or failure to locate supplies the recoverable condition.
Course, manner, and intended direction turn recovery into an oriented life-path.

changed_reading.before: Finding and guiding are two loosely adjacent divine acts.
changed_reading.after: Finding is recovery, while guiding is the second, nonredundant act of giving the recovered one a course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The motion from ضَالًّا to هَدَىٰ can recruit the h-d-y image of walking while supported and swaying.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance need not be only verbal indication: an unstable traveler can be accompanied bodily until a composed bearing becomes possible.

activation_trace.role: Being off the intended way supplies the travel instability that requires assistance.
Supported, swaying walking turns guidance into accompaniment that bears weakness.
Calm and composed bearing supplies the embodied result of that accompaniment.

changed_reading.before: Guidance points out a route to an otherwise self-moving traveler.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may accompany and steady the off-course traveler until movement itself acquires composure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories permit ضَالًّا as failed retention, وَجَدَ as mental apprehension, and هَدَىٰ as clarification.
baseline_models.mechanism: A cognitive rather than condemnatory reading becomes live: what was not retained or articulated is apprehended and clarified into a communicable way.

activation_trace.role: Loss of retention or forgetting supplies a deficit of held knowledge.
Perceptual or mental finding supplies apprehension of what was unavailable.
Clarifying a truth or way turns recovered apprehension into intelligible direction.

changed_reading.before: ضَالًّا must indicate moral or doctrinal deviation.
changed_reading.after: It can exploratorily indicate unretained or unformulated knowledge that guidance renders apprehensible and clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation between exposed, clear morning and settled, covering night turns the focus transition into a visibility cycle: ضَالًّا is a covered phase, finding is disclosure, and guidance is dawnlike legibility.

activation_trace.role: Encounter supplies the moment at which the covered subject becomes discoverable.
Hiddenness supplies the focus state that the light-dark context can modulate.
Clarification of a way supplies the transition into legibility.
Emergence into sunlight and visibility gives guidance a disclosure image.
Night darkness supplies the contrasting field in which a subject can be obscured.
Settled stillness with the night closing over things makes concealment a phase rather than abandonment.

structural_cues: 93:1-2 establish alternating visible and covered conditions before 93:3 denies abandonment and before the focus triad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies morning exposure, night darkness, settled closure, focus hiddenness, and clarification; I supply the arrow from nocturnal covering to dawnlike disclosure, while a live alternative is that the opening pair marks cosmic reassurance without redescribing ضَالًّا.

changed_reading.before: The hiddenness reading is a static synonym for being lost.
changed_reading.after: Hiddenness becomes a temporary covered phase whose reversal into visibility is itself part of what هَدَىٰ accomplishes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of leaving and heart-distance, combined with lordly repair, cultivation, and even the split-root image of growth, revises guidance from a one-time correction into sustained custodial formation.

activation_trace.role: Finding supplies active attention to one who could otherwise remain unlocated.
The lost condition supplies the vulnerability to abandonment that the context explicitly negates.
Giving a course supplies the formative outcome of continued care.
Leaving and relinquishing name the relation explicitly denied, so finding remains ongoing custody.
Repair, upbringing, and completion make guidance a developmental practice.
The non-dominant growth and nourishment image deepens cultivation while remaining a form-distant activation.
Hatred that distances the heart supplies the second rejected mode of relation.

structural_cues: The paired negations in 93:3 define the enduring relation before 93:6-8 recount three found conditions and their remedies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relinquishment, heart-distance, repair, upbringing, and a split-root growth image; I infer that their negation and contrast make guidance sustained cultivation, while the live alternative is a simpler assurance of affection followed by an otherwise discrete act of direction.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an instantaneous switch from wrong route to right route.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is the course-forming labor of a custodian who neither leaves nor distances the vulnerable subject and instead repairs, raises, and completes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later-over-first comparison and promised giving toward satisfaction stretch هَدَىٰ across time: it initiates a course whose beneficial outcome is not exhausted by the moment of being found.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from aim supplies the trajectory's initial misalignment.
Course and intended direction let guidance extend beyond a point event.
Deferral to a later time opens a temporal horizon for the guided course.
Beneficial good supplies the value toward which the course tends.
Return to an outcome or final consequence makes the first phase readable from its eventual issue.
Giving supplies concrete provision along the course rather than direction alone.
Satisfaction opposed to discontent marks an affective fruition of the trajectory.

structural_cues: 93:4 compares a later phase with a first one, and 93:5 follows with future giving before 93:6-8 recount past transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies laterness, beneficial good, outcome, giving, satisfaction, and the focus image of intended course; I infer a trajectory from guidance toward fruition, while live alternatives are an exclusively eschatological comparison or separate promises with no process-link to 93:7.

changed_reading.before: فَهَدَىٰ closes the lostness episode immediately.
changed_reading.after: فَهَدَىٰ opens a directed trajectory whose later good, provision, and satisfaction can disclose what the initial guidance was doing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-abandonment cue and the non-dominant w-l-y images of nearness and close succession activate the fa in فَهَدَىٰ as care following the found condition without a relational gap.

activation_trace.role: The encounter supplies the first event in the closely linked pair.
Course-giving supplies the action that follows encounter as its immediate continuation.
Relinquishment, under explicit negation, rules out a break between encounter and care.
The split-root image of nearness without an interval activates continuity across the transition.
Close succession of one thing after another supplies a temporal image for the focus fa.

structural_cues: The focus uses fa between the diagnosed state and remedy, and the neighboring recollection triads repeat the same linkage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated relinquishment, nearness, succession, and the focus fa; I infer an unbroken care relation between finding and guiding, while the live alternative is that the w-l-y target is merely a form-distant split activation and fa marks ordinary sequence only.

changed_reading.before: Finding and guidance may be separated episodes.
changed_reading.after: The exploratory split-root resonance makes guidance the close, gapless continuation of being found under non-abandoning care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated found-you/state/fa-remedy pattern places ضَالًّا between orphaned exposure answered by shelter and material need answered by sufficiency; it becomes one vulnerable condition met by its fitting provision, not an isolated verdict.

activation_trace.role: Finding supplies the repeated diagnostic encounter shared by the three recollections.
Being off aim is the middle condition in the parallel need-remedy series.
Guidance is the remedy fitted specifically to disorientation.
The earlier repeated finding establishes the shared frame for vulnerable conditions.
Severance of a child from a caretaker supplies the first relational deficit.
Joining a gathering refuge supplies the matching repair for severed care.
The later repeated finding closes the structural frame around the focus.
Poverty and need supply the third deficit in the parallel series.
Sufficiency supplies the fitting repair for material lack.

structural_cues: 93:6-8 repeat a finding clause, an accusative condition, and a fa-linked remedy, with 93:7 occupying the middle slot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three matched grammatical frames and branch pairs of severance/refuge, disorientation/guidance, and poverty/sufficiency; I infer a condition-specific care matrix, while a live alternative is that parallel rhetoric does not lessen any moral force carried by ضَالًّا.

changed_reading.before: 93:7 stands alone as a special accusation followed by correction.
changed_reading.after: 93:7 is the middle case in a care matrix where each exposed lack is noticed and met with the provision proper to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The third triad's ع ي ل inventory unexpectedly includes the bewilderment of a stray about its destination; under identical syntax, that image back-activates ضَالًّا as navigational bewilderment and lets sufficiency mean provision of capacity for the way.

activation_trace.role: Failure to locate a fixed place anchors the focus condition in navigational loss.
Course and intended direction provide what destination-bewilderment lacks.
Repeated finding licenses the neighboring branch image to echo back into the focus frame.
A stray's confusion about its destination closely mirrors the focus problem of unlocated direction.
Sufficiency recasts the remedy as furnishing enough capacity to proceed.

structural_cues: The identical 93:7 and 93:8 syntax places ضَالًّا beside a root whose inventory itself contains destination-bewilderment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax, focus loss of location, neighboring destination-bewilderment, and sufficiency; I infer that the third triad lends a capacity-deficit model to guidance, while the live alternative is the ordinary poverty-to-enrichment reading of 93:8 with no semantic feedback.

changed_reading.before: The lost one lacks only information about which route is correct.
changed_reading.after: The lost one may lack navigational capacity or sufficiency, so guidance equips movement rather than merely supplying an answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired prohibitions exclude domination from above and harsh verbal repulsion; the n-h-r opening/flow image and the split s-l-l images of gentle extraction and smooth flow then activate a positive mode in which guidance opens passage and draws the vulnerable traveler without crushing.

activation_trace.role: The off-course condition anchors the social mode under discussion to the focus traveler.
Gentle indication supplies the focus-side alternative to force.
Loss of a caretaker identifies the vulnerable person on whom guiding power must not bear down.
Dominance from above that humiliates the overpowered supplies the rejected coercive mode.
Question and request identify another person whose lack calls for responsive direction.
The split-root image of drawing out gently and quietly supplies an exploratory noncoercive motion.
Smooth flowing supplies continuity without violent displacement.
Harsh verbal rebuke supplies the explicitly prohibited speech mode.
Opening and widening until flow is possible supplies a cross-branch positive counterimage to rebuff.

structural_cues: 93:9-10 form parallel negative commands immediately after the three remembered remedies, converting received care into a rule for handling vulnerable others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle focus guidance, prohibited domination and rebuke, plus form-distant images of gentle extraction, smooth flow, and opening; I infer a positive guiding ethic from those contrasts, while live alternatives are that the commands regulate conduct only and that the split-root s-l-l images should remain lexical echoes rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guidance can be imagined as authoritative correction imposed on the lost.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is constrained by its social afterlife: it opens a channel and draws forth gently, refusing the power that crushes or verbally drives away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final imperative gathers the guided transition as a favorable condition to be manifested in renewing speech; guidance moves from private past event to a tellable event that can become newly present for hearers.

activation_trace.role: Existence or becoming present lets the found event be treated as something made manifest.
Clarification of a way supplies the content that can be made available to others.
Favorable condition and blessing classify the transition as received good rather than self-produced mastery.
Repair, upbringing, and completion preserve the formative agent inside the narrated event.
Coming to be after not being supplies eventfulness and renewed presence.
Speech renewed as report makes the guidance transition tellable.
Bringing something out and displaying it supplies the public manifestation of received guidance.

structural_cues: The closing imperative follows the remembered triad and retrospectively converts its events into material for speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blessing, formative completion, event-emergence, renewed report, and manifestation; I infer that recounting makes the guided way socially present again, while the live alternative is simple thanksgiving that reports a completed private favor without extending its guiding function.

changed_reading.before: The guidance of 93:7 is a completed inward transition.
changed_reading.after: The transition is also narratable guidance: speaking it as received favor renews and manifests a way for a wider social field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from personal guidance into pastoral and ritual imagery; it remains anchored in focus branches for finding a lost thing, a stray in a wasteland, and an offering led to sanctuary. Downstream prose should present it only as an image-level analogy of recovery, custody, and purposive leading, never as a claim that the addressee is literally an animal or sacrificial victim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: All three material images arise from وَجَدَكَ, ضَالًّا, and هَدَىٰ in the focus inventories.

activation_trace.role: Finding a sought or lost thing supplies recovery into custody.
A stray animal exposed in a wasteland supplies the vulnerable material scene.
An offering led to sanctuary changes bare retrieval into protected, purposive leading.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only correction of an erroneous human belief or route.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it can stage recovery of an exposed stray into custody and a protected destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links inward sorrow or love, hiddenness, and the gift branch of h-d-y rather than its ordinary guidance branch. It remains focus-anchored in all three roots and preserves the same encounter-to-response grammar; downstream prose should call it an affective resonance, not replace the lexical reading of هَدَىٰ as guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can align وَجَدَ as inward affect, ضَالًّا as concealed presence, and هَدَىٰ as a gracious sending to one held close.

activation_trace.role: Inward sorrow or love gives the encounter an affective interior.
Hiddenness makes that interior affect unmanifest before the transition.
A gracious gift sent to someone loved or close renders guidance as an intimate answering gift.

changed_reading.before: Guidance answers only an external directional defect.
changed_reading.after: As an affective resonance, guidance can answer a concealed interior of sorrow or longing as a gracious gift of nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the non-dominant j-d-d target mapped from focus w-j-d. It remains valid as packet-authorized split-root activation and still attaches to the focus sequence through hiddenness and course; downstream prose must describe renewal-after-cut as a resonance, not claim that وَجَدَ literally means renewal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory under focus وَجَدَ supplies newness after cutting, while ضَالًّا and هَدَىٰ supply obscurity and a newly intended course.

activation_trace.role: Newness arising after a cut supplies the exploratory image of renewed emergence.
Hiddenness supplies the interval or obscured condition from which renewal emerges.
An intended course gives renewed emergence a direction rather than mere novelty.

changed_reading.before: The transition restores a route without altering the mode of existence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the transition can feel like a newly constituted course emerging after interruption or obscurity.

strongest_changes: The light-night opening turns hiddenness into a phase that guidance reverses through disclosure.
The denial of abandonment and the ربّ images revise guidance into sustained repair, cultivation, and completion.
The three repeated condition-remedy frames make ضَالًّا one vulnerable lack among orphaned exposure and material need, each met by fitting care.
The later-good and future-giving sequence stretches guidance into a trajectory with provision and affective fruition.
The closing prohibitions and imperative make received guidance socially consequential: it must neither coerce the vulnerable nor remain privately untold.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms rather than one disambiguated gloss: route correction, recovery from hiddenness, locating a lost one, embodied support, cognitive clarification, non-abandoning formation, temporal fruition, and socially renewed guidance. Split-root branches added live but contained readings of unbroken succession, gentle extraction, growth, and renewal after severance.
remaining_uncertainties: The balance between moral deviation, navigational bewilderment, hiddenness, and cognitive non-retention remains unresolved; the parallel triads strengthen vulnerability without eliminating moral force.
The non-dominant j-d-d, w-l-y, r-b-w, and s-l-l activations are productive but form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The embodied, pastoral, ritual, and affective readings are mechanism-bearing analogies, not replacements for the dominant guidance sense.
It remains open whether later benefit and public narration are intrinsic continuations of هَدَىٰ or contextual consequences layered onto a completed act.
